---
title: "Deconvolution with BisqueRNA - Estimation of Hippocampal Cell Types"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# Import libraries required
library(Matrix)
library(Biobase)
library(BisqueRNA)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(RColorBrewer)
```


```{r}
# 1. Read snRNA reference: counts matrix + metadata
dl <- file.path(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE"), "Downloads")

counts <- t(readMM(file.path(dl, "adata_reference_matrix.mtx")))  # genes x cells
counts <- as(counts, "CsparseMatrix")
obs <- read.delim(file.path(dl, "adata_reference_barcodes.tsv"),
                  header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
var <- read.delim(file.path(dl, "adata_reference_features.tsv"),
                  header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
```


```{r}
# To inspect structure of snRNA reference data
dim(obs)
str(obs)
colnames(obs)
head(obs)

sapply(obs, function(x) length(unique(x)))
```


```{r}
dim(counts)   # should be genes x cells  
nrow(obs)     # number of cells — should equal ncol(counts)
nrow(var)     # number of genes — should equal nrow(counts)
```


```{r}
samp_meta <- unique(obs[, c("Sample","AgeGroup_5","Sex","Age","Batch")])
rownames(samp_meta) <- samp_meta$Sample
samp_meta <- samp_meta[colnames(pb), ]
identical(rownames(samp_meta), colnames(pb))  
```


```{r}
# 2. Import Bulk RNA-samples: genes x samples
bulk <- read.delim(file.path(dl, "gene_count_matrix_hippo.txt"),
                   row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

bulk.matrix <- as.matrix(bulk)

dim(bulk.matrix)
colnames(bulk.matrix)

bulk.eset <- ExpressionSet(assayData = bulk.matrix)
```

```{r}
# 3. Use BisqueRNA to estimate proportion of cell types

res <- ReferenceBasedDecomposition(
  bulk.eset = bulk.eset,
  sc.eset = sc.eset,
  markers = NULL,        # optional marker gene list
  use.overlap = FALSE    # In this case, we use FALSE as there are no cohort overlaps
)

# Estimated proportions: cell types x bulk samples
est_props <- res$bulk.props
est_props[1:5, 1:5]   
```

```{r}
# To inspect cell types
rownames(est_props)
```


```{r}
## To plot out all clusters (cell types)

# Reshape dataset
df <- melt(est_props, varnames = c("CellType", "Sample"), value.name = "Proportion")
df$Sample <- as.character(df$Sample)

# Map cell types clusters to show (the rest will go to "Others")
keep <- c("Astrocytes", "CA1", "CA2/MC", "CA3.1", "CA3.2", "Cajal-Retzius",
          "Choroid Plexus", "GABA.N", "GC", "HATA/AHi", "L2/3", "L5",
          "L6/6b", "ProS/Sub", "Microglia", "Oligodendrocytes", "OPC", "Ependymal", "Endothelial")

print(sort(unique(trimws(as.character(df$CellType)))))

ct <- trimws(as.character(df$CellType))

# Match on make.names() versions so "CA2/MC" and "CA2.MC" both count
lookup <- setNames(keep, make.names(keep))
mapped <- unname(lookup[make.names(ct)])

# Merge subclusters into their family
mapped[grepl("^Astro", ct)] <- "Astrocytes"
mapped[grepl("^GC", ct)]    <- "GC"

df$CellType <- ifelse(is.na(mapped), "Others", mapped)
df <- aggregate(Proportion ~ CellType + Sample, data = df, FUN = sum)

# Get DIVs from bulk sample names
div <- as.numeric(str_extract(df$Sample, "(?<=DIV)\\d+"))

# DIV numbers that have an extra "1" in sample names
div_fix <- c("1001" = 100, "111" = 11)
hit <- as.character(div) %in% names(div_fix)
div[hit] <- div_fix[as.character(div[hit])]

# Assign DIVs to culture stages
div_to_group <- c(
  "0"   = 1,
  "11"  = 2,
  "40"  = 3,
  "60"  = 4, "110" = 4,
  "82"  = 5, "84" = 5, "100" = 5,
  "154" = 6, "180" = 6, "200" = 6
)
df$Group <- unname(div_to_group[as.character(div)])

if (any(is.na(df$Group))) {
  warning("Unmapped DIV values: ", paste(unique(div[is.na(df$Group)]), collapse = ", "))
}

df$Group <- factor(df$Group, levels = 1:6,
                   labels = c("G1: DIV0", "G2: DIV11", "G3: DIV40",
                              "G4: DIV60", "G5: DIV82-100", "G6: DIV154-200"))

# Average across replicates within culture stages
df_grp <- aggregate(Proportion ~ CellType + Group, data = df, FUN = mean)


df_grp$CellType <- factor(df_grp$CellType, levels = c(keep, "Others"))

# For colours
pool <- c(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"),
          RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")[1:7])

n <- length(keep)
cols <- if (n <= length(pool)) pool[seq_len(n)] else hcl.colors(n, palette = "Dynamic")

pal <- c(setNames(cols, keep), "Others" = "#BDBDBD")

# Plot by culture stages
p_grp <- ggplot(df_grp, aes(x = Group, y = Proportion, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean estimated proportion", fill = "Cell type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )
print(p_grp)
```
